column1: # ConText/NegEx-style cue lists for the text reader (matched on whole tokens, case-insensitive).
# type: pre = negates the terms that follow; post = negates the term just before (within 4 tokens);
#       hedge = makes the terms that follow uncertain; pseudo = looks like a cue but is not one;
#       contrast / termination = end the scope of a pre or hedge cue. Commas, "or" and "and" do not end a scope.
